purpose: Independent oracle for the trading calendars in K1694.py. Every entry below is hand-transcribed from the primary source named in `source_id` and resolved in `sources`. NOTHING here may be derived from K1694.py -- that is the whole point: Codex round 5 blocked because the only endpoint test fed expected_month_endpoints() back into the implementation that produced it, so it could not falsify a wrong calendar. These fixtures can.
how_to_verify: Open the URL in `sources`, find the quoted sentence, and check it against the `open` / `closed` value. The weekday arithmetic in month_fixtures (how many Mon-Fri dates a month contains) is plain calendar arithmetic and is NOT a claim about any exchange; the exchange claim is only which of those weekdays are closed.

unverified_dates.searched_for: an ICE Futures U.S. exchange notice or ICE press release stating whether the softs traded on the 2018 national day of mourning
unverified_dates.outcome: NOT FOUND. ICE's own 2018 holiday calendar predates the event (notice dated 2017-07-06) and therefore cannot speak to it, and no ICE notice for that date surfaced.
unverified_dates.treatment: No closure is asserted for ICEUS_SOFTS on this date: an unsourced closure is exactly the defect this round is repairing. The calendar therefore treats 2018-12-05 as a normal trading day for the ICE softs too.
unverified_dates.materiality: None for the reported sample. See `insensitivity_check` in K1694_results.json -- the CORN row that leaves the sample is a CME_GLOBEX_COMMODITY row, and asserting an ICE closure on this date changes no row either way.

month_fixtures.derivation: October 2012 has 23 Mon-Fri dates. None of the ten sourced closed holidays falls in October (Columbus Day, Mon 2012-10-08, is a trading day). Hurricane Sandy closed no product K1694 uses -- CFTC-12-363.
Same arithmetic; ICE-PR-2012-10-29 keeps the softs open on 29 and 30 October.
December 2018 has 21 Mon-Fri dates. Christmas (Tue 2018-12-25) is the only sourced closure. 2018-12-05 is a trading day -- CME-PR-2018-12-02.
October 2020 has 22 Mon-Fri dates; Columbus Day (Mon 2020-10-12) trades.
June 2020 has 22 Mon-Fri dates; Juneteenth was not yet observed by CME (first observed 2022).
June 2021 has 22 Mon-Fri dates. CME did not close for Juneteenth in 2021 -- CME-JUNETEENTH-2022 records 2022 as the first observance.
June 2022 has 22 Mon-Fri dates; Juneteenth 6/19 fell on a Sunday and was observed Monday 6/20 -- CME-JUNETEENTH-2022.
November 2016 has 22 Mon-Fri dates. Thanksgiving (Thu 2016-11-24) is closed; Veterans Day (Fri 2016-11-11) trades.
ICEUS-CAL-2018 lists Christmas as the only December closure. 2018-12-05 is carried as a trading day because no source says otherwise -- see unverified_dates.
October 2020 has 22 Mon-Fri dates and the ICE softs column carries no October holiday (Columbus Day, Mon 2020-10-12, is 'open' in ICEUS-CAL-2019 and ICEUS-CAL-2026).
